summary: Round Top lookout in the Berkeley Hills: 60-foot steel tower built 1927, active to 1973, removed before 1986; summit now in Sibley Volcanic Regional Preserve.

facts.design: 7x7 observation-only cabin atop a 60-foot X-brace open steel tower
facts.status_note: Removed after 1973 and before the 1986 Thornton survey; no source describes what remains at the site

access.note: Summit lies in Sibley Volcanic Regional Preserve, a park established by the East Bay Regional Parks District; no source read gives current summit hours or rules

events.note: Committee started a graded road to the summit in January 1927
FFLOS: constructed and dedicated May 1927. Berkeley Daily Gazette (Sept 1927, quoted by Forest Lookouts): completed June 1, dedication planned that week
Brush fire in Claremont Canyon reported by the new tower on July 1, 1927 and quickly extinguished
Tower described as active as late as 1973
Removed after 1973 and before the 1986 Thornton survey; 1986 is the latest possible date, not an exact one
Registered January 9, 2021; nominated by Brad Eells

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register says the lookout was constructed and dedicated in May 1927. A September 1927 Berkeley Daily Gazette report, quoted on Forest Lookouts, says it was completed June 1 with dedication that week. Both put the build in 1927; the story reports both dates and does not pick one.

The register names the Contra Costa Hills Protective Committee; 1927 press quotes name the Contra Costa Hills Fire Protection Committee. These appear to be the same body. The story uses the register's name for the agency.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1986 removal date is an outer limit: the register gives 'After 1973, prior to 1986', so the story says the removal happened in that window. Access 'public' is inferred from the site lying in an EBRPD regional park; no source read gives summit hours or rules, so confirm with EBRPD before publishing. No source read names who staffed the tower, so the staffing section is omitted. No photos added: a 1927 Fritz-Metcalf photo (digicoll.lib.berkeley.edu/record/15455) and a calisphere copy (calisphere.org/item/013ec25fb096d8f3b7b08500eee6ddd3) appeared in search results but were not opened, so license is unchecked. The May versus June 1927 opening conflict is unresolved; a Berkeley Daily Gazette copy or a dedication notice would settle it.
